heroRole: NAATI Certified Translator Spanish to English
intro:
I am Georgina, an Argentine translator now based in Sydney.
I have always believed that language has the power to open doors to entirely new worlds. And over time, translation became far more than just a job for me, it became my way of connecting cultures, people, and experiences.
As a NAATI Certified Spanish to English Translator, I specialise in migration, legal, and academic translations. I'm also a member of AUSIT (the Australian Institute of Interpreters and Translators) which means my work follows a strict code of ethics and ongoing professional development standards.
My goal is to help the spanish speaking community navigate these important steps with total clarity and confidence. I also partner with brands to localise their content, ensuring their message feels natural, culturally relevant, and genuinely human.
Translation has taught me that meaning lives beyond the words themselves, that behind every document, there is a major milestone: a life change, a new opportunity, a business expanding, or someone who simply needs to be understood.
While I welcome the efficiency of modern technology and AI, I know that context, nuance, and human insight remain irreplaceable for true precision.
If you need a translation that preserves meaning, context, and clarity, I'd love to help. Let's get in touch.
service1Text: Professional certified Spanish to English translations for migration, legal, academic, and official purposes across Australia.
service2Text: Localisation goes beyond words. Because successful communication depends on true cultural connection, I adapt your content so it respects context, carries the right tone, and resonates naturally with your target audience.
service3Text: A thorough review of your translated or written content that refines tone, flow, and consistency, catching the nuances automated grammar checkers miss.
timelineStep1Title: Complete the form and send your documents
timelineStep1Description: Upload your files through the secure request form on the contact page, or send them via WhatsApp or email. Make sure your documents are clear and legible (in PDF, JPG, Word, or scanned format) so I can accurately assess your project requirements right from the start.
timelineStep2Description: Let me know the purpose of your project (migration, legal, academic, business, other), the type of service you need (transaltion, NAATI translation, localisation, proofreading, revision, or other), and your preferred deadline.  This details help me determine the best approach, delivery format, and turnaround time for your specific needs.
timelineStep3Title: Receive a detailed quote + turnaround time
timelineStep3Description: Within one business day, you will receive a transparent quote outlining all project details including project cost and estimated delivery date.
timelineStep4Title: Confirm the quote and secure payment
timelineStep4Description: Once you approve the quote and complete the deposit payment, your project will be officially booked into my schedule. This ensures a confirmed delivery timeline and a smooth process from start to finish.
timelineStep5Description: Your completed project will be delivered electronically, including any agreed formatting, certifications, supporting documentation, or project files where applicable. Once you have received and reviewed the final files, the remaining balance will be due within 24 hs of final delivery.
